d:
Brazil Election 2026 has witnessed a historic political comeback! President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has defeated Flávio Bolsonaro to secure a fourth term, despite trailing in the first round.
Lula won 51.79% of the votes, while Bolsonaro secured 48.21%, marking one of the biggest election turnarounds in Brazil's modern democratic history.
But how did Lula reverse the results in just three weeks? What role did voter turnout, social media campaigns, Northeast Brazil, and Donald Trump's political influence play in this election?
